ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, segment $AB=12$, point $C$ is the midpoint of segment $AB$, and point $D$ is the midpoint of segment $BC$. What is the length of segment $AD$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given $\because AB=12$ and C is the midpoint of AB,\\
$\therefore AC=BC=6$,\\
$\because D$ is the midpoint of $BC$,\\
$\therefore CD=\frac{1}{2}BC=3$,\\
$\therefore AD=AC+CD=\boxed{9}$.
